atoms.name: High Confidence
atoms.description: Confidence tier for facts verified from authoritative primary sources. Threshold: 0.9-1.0.

content.definition: A high-confidence fact has been verified from at least one authoritative primary source (official documentation, signed commits, or direct measurement). Suitable for automated decision-making.
